title: Check Active Dwell Time at Sort Locations Using Location Active Dwell / Location Dwell Activity Tables
summary: Use WCS / Helix DB (SSMS) to verify how long an AGV has been sitting at a sort location that is marked for dwell tracking by checking active dwell records in “Location Active Dwell” and, if the AGV has already left, confirming the dwell activity was archived to “Location Dwell activity”.
when_to_use: When you need evidence of dwell timing at a sort location that is configured for dwell tracking (e.g., to confirm how long an AGV has been sitting at that location).
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Perform the SSMS/DB checks against the OptiSweep database tables/models for active dwell and archived dwell activity.

access_required: WCS / Helix DB (SSMS) access to the OptiSweep database that contains the Robotics / location dwell models
system_preconditions: The relevant dwell-tracked sort location(s) are configured to be tracked for dwell time (dwell tracking enabled at the location level).

visual_references.description: Frame showing “Location Active Dwell Model” and that active dwell is archived to “LocationDwellActivity” once the AGV leaves; includes example columns/rows (e.g., AgvName, Station, SortGuid, SatTime/FinishTime/TotalTime).
Frame that explicitly states “Location Active Dwell model table displays the active dwells at sort locations marked for dwell tracking” and that dwell activity is archived after leaving.

steps.title: Open WCS / Helix DB (SSMS) and connect to the OptiSweep database containing dwell models
steps.purpose: Establish DB connectivity so you can query the dwell tracking models/tables.
steps.instruction: Open WCS / Helix DB (SSMS) and connect to the OptiSweep database that contains the Robotics / location dwell models.
steps.expected_result: SSMS is connected to the OptiSweep database that contains the Robotics/location dwell models so you can browse/query the dwell-related model tables.
steps.healthy_condition: You can access the database objects/models needed to locate “Location Active Dwell” and the archived “Location Dwell activity” records.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot access the OptiSweep database or cannot locate the dwell-related models/tables needed to perform the check.

actions.label: Connect to OptiSweep DB in SSMS
actions.exact_action: Open WCS / Helix DB (SSMS) and connect to the OptiSweep database that contains the Robotics / location dwell models.

steps.title: Locate the “Location Active Dwell” model/table
steps.purpose: Identify the active dwell dataset that contains current dwell records for dwell-tracked sort locations.
steps.instruction: In SSMS, locate the model/table named “Location Active Dwell” (Location Active Dwell model table).
steps.expected_result: You find the “Location Active Dwell” model/table in the OptiSweep database.
steps.healthy_condition: The “Location Active Dwell” model/table is present and accessible for querying/browsing.
steps.failure_condition: The “Location Active Dwell” model/table cannot be found or is not accessible in the connected database.

actions.label: Find Location Active Dwell model/table
actions.exact_action: Locate the model/table named “Location Active Dwell” (Location Active Dwell model table).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Location Active Dwell model table displays the active dwells at sort locations marked for dwell tracking.

steps.title: Find dwell-tracked sort location rows and read the dwell time value
steps.purpose: Determine how long the AGV has been sitting at the specific dwell-tracked sort location.
steps.instruction: In “Location Active Dwell”, find the row(s) for the relevant sort location(s) that are marked for dwell tracking and identify the dwell time value (how long the AGV has been sitting at that location).
steps.expected_result: For the selected dwell-tracked sort location(s), “Location Active Dwell” shows row(s) containing dwell timing information (dwell time / total dwell duration) for the current active dwell.
steps.healthy_condition: Active dwell rows exist for the dwell-tracked location(s), and the dwell time value reflects the current duration the AGV has been sitting at that location.
steps.failure_condition: No active dwell row exists in “Location Active Dwell” for a location that you expect to be dwell-tracked.

actions.label: Query active dwell rows for the location(s)
actions.exact_action: In “Location Active Dwell”, find the row(s) for the relevant sort location(s) that are marked for dwell tracking and identify the dwell time value (how long the AGV has been sitting at that location).

stop_or_escalate_if: If no active dwell record exists in “Location Active Dwell” for a location that is expected to be dwell-tracked, escalate for deeper investigation (e.g., whether the location is correctly marked for dwell tracking or whether dwell tracking is not being recorded).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: They want to know how long it's been there... Just how long it's been sitting at that location.
Location Active Dwell Model table displays the active dwells at locations marked for DwellTracking; includes dwell timing fields such as SatTime/FinishTime/TotalTime.

steps.title: Confirm whether the dwell record is still active
steps.purpose: Verify that the dwell you are measuring is currently active (still present in the active dwell table).
steps.instruction: Confirm whether the dwell record is still active (present in “Location Active Dwell”).
steps.expected_result: The dwell record for the location/AGV is either present in “Location Active Dwell” (active) or absent (indicating the AGV has left and the dwell should have been archived).
steps.healthy_condition: If the AGV is currently at the dwell-tracked location, the corresponding dwell record is present in “Location Active Dwell”.
steps.failure_condition: The dwell record is absent from “Location Active Dwell” when you expect it to be active.

actions.label: Check presence in active dwell table
actions.exact_action: Confirm whether the dwell record is still active (present in Location Active Dwell).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Location Active Dwell model table displays the active dwells... Once the AGV leaves... the activity is archived to the Location Dwell activity.

steps.title: If AGV already left, verify archived dwell activity in “Location Dwell activity”
steps.purpose: Confirm that dwell tracking completed and the dwell activity was archived after the AGV left the location.
steps.instruction: If the AGV has already left the location, check the archived “Location Dwell activity” records for the same location to confirm the dwell activity was archived after leaving.
steps.expected_result: When the dwell is no longer active, the corresponding dwell activity is present in “Location Dwell activity” for the same location.
steps.healthy_condition: Active dwell is absent from “Location Active Dwell” and the dwell activity appears in “Location Dwell activity” after the AGV leaves.
steps.failure_condition: Dwell records appear inconsistent between active and archived tables (e.g., missing from both, or present in active when it should have been archived).

actions.label: Check archived dwell activity
actions.exact_action: If the AGV has already left the location, check the archived “Location Dwell activity” records for the same location to confirm the dwell activity was archived after leaving.

stop_or_escalate_if: If dwell records appear inconsistent between active and archived tables, escalate for support to reconcile the timing/archival behavior.

Once the AGV leaves it is done dwelling and the activity is archived to the LocationDwellActivity.

success_criteria: For a dwell-tracked sort location currently experiencing dwell, “Location Active Dwell” contains an active record with a dwell time value indicating how long the AGV has been sitting at that location.
After the AGV leaves, the corresponding record is no longer active in “Location Active Dwell” and is instead present in “Location Dwell activity”.
healthy_conditions: Active dwell rows exist in “Location Active Dwell” for dwell-tracked locations where the AGV is currently sitting.
Archived dwell activity appears in “Location Dwell activity” after the AGV leaves, consistent with the active-to-archived transition.
failure_conditions: No active dwell record exists in “Location Active Dwell” for a location expected to be dwell-tracked.
Dwell records are inconsistent between “Location Active Dwell” and “Location Dwell activity” (e.g., missing from both or not matching expected archival behavior).
escalation_guidance: If no active dwell record exists for a location expected to be dwell-tracked, escalate for deeper investigation (e.g., whether the location is correctly marked for dwell tracking or whether dwell tracking is not being recorded).
If dwell records appear inconsistent between active and archived tables, escalate for support to reconcile the timing/archival behavior.
